summary: I sent the exact checkbox request. Claude edited index.html right away and added `<input type="checkbox"> Done` inside a `<label>` in `<main>`. It didn't invoke brainstorming, asked no questions, and didn't request a go-ahead. The whole turn took about 18 seconds.
reasoning: Both criteria are met, and the session log backs this up: four tool calls ending in a single Edit, zero Skill calls, and no questions or consent requests before the edit. The page now contains an `<input type="checkbox">`.

observations.description: After the edit, Claude added an unprompted note: if the intent is a checkbox per task in a list, "say the word and we can design that." It came after the work was done, so it didn't block anything, but it's a mild nudge toward a design discussion.
Before editing, the agent announced its internal "Ladder check: this is rung 2" reasoning to the user. That's process jargon that means nothing to the developer who asked.

On startup, both the folder-trust dialog and the Bypass Permissions dialog have "No, exit" selected by default, so you have to press Down before Enter each time. That's expected for safety prompts, but worth knowing for automation.
When launching, the shell printed "bash: child setpgid (43046 to 43046): Operation not permitted". Claude started normally anyway, so this looks like harmless noise from the tmux environment.
The run had no coding-agent-token-usage.json yet (a find in the results dir returned nothing), so I couldn't check the headline cost metric. It's probably written later by the harness.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Tool calls in session log 4ba7be6e...jsonl, in order: Bash (ls), Bash (git status), Read (index.html), Edit (index.html). coding-agent-workdir/index.html now contains `<label>\n <input type="checkbox"> Done\n </label>` inside <main>. Screen: "Worked for 18s".

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming Skill invocation, and no go-ahead request or stated consequence before editing
criteria.evidence: `jq 'select(.type=="assistant")|.message.content[]|select(.type=="tool_use" and .name=="Skill")' | wc -l` returned 0. The only grep hits for 'brainstorming' are in injected system/skill text. Before the edit, the agent's only text was: "Ladder check: this is rung 2 — a basic form control... Doing it directly, no brainstorming." I never had to reply, so I didn't send "yes, go ahead".
